name: Budget Exposé
description: Questions designed to surface budget allocation vs release discrepancies

questions.question: How much did Kano State budget for education in 2024 and how much was actually released?
What is the total healthcare budget for Borno State in 2024 compared to 2023? Break down capital vs recurrent spending.
Show me the infrastructure spending in Lagos State 2024 budget breakdown. How much went to roads vs water vs energy?
How much did Ebonyi State budget for agriculture in 2025? What percentage of the total budget does agriculture represent?
What is the education budget per student in Zamfara State for 2024? How does the capital expenditure compare to recurrent?
How much did Rivers State allocate to healthcare in their 2024 budget? What could that money build in terms of hospitals and health centers?
What is the total budget for Kaduna State in 2025? How much is capital expenditure vs recurrent? What percentage goes to education?
How much did Bayelsa State spend on water resources in 2024? How many boreholes could that money have built?
